title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
频域 band-limited CT signal \(X(j \omega)=0\) for \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) 
Sampling frequency \(\omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{T}\)
Case 1: \(\omega_{s}>2 \omega_{M}\) no overlap between replicas can recover \(X\) by lowpass filtering 
Case 2: \(\omega_{s}<2 \omega_{M}\) replicas overlap cannot recover \(X\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
采样定理
Band-limited CT signal \(x(t)\) whose spectrum \(X(j \omega)=0\) for \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x(n T), n \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text { called Nyquist rate }
\]
Given \(\{x(n T): n \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x(t)\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(T\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

filter output \(x_{r}(t)\) with \(X_{r}(j \omega)=X_{p}(j \omega) H(j \omega)\) is same as \(x(t)\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域中的重建
Setting \(\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}\) yields Whittaker-Shannon interpolation formula
\[
x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text { where } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}
\]
Since
\[
\operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} T e^{-j n T \omega}\left[u\left(\omega+\frac{\pi}{T}\right)-u\left(\omega-\frac{\pi}{T}\right)\right]
\]
Parseval’s identity (or multiplication property) implies
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-m T}{T}\right) d t=\frac{T^{2}}{2 \pi} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{T}}^{\frac{\pi}{T}} e^{j(m-n) T \omega} d \omega=T \delta[n-m]
\]
Whittaker-Shannon formula is orthogonal expansion

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的卷积性质
\[
(x * h)[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
NB. Dual of multiplication property of CTFS
\[
x(t) y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow}(\hat{x} * \hat{y})[k]
\]
NB. Similar to CTFT, applicable when formula is well-defined Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x * h\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}(x * h)[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} \sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] e^{-j \omega m} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \\
& =X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
LTI 系统的频率响应
LTI system \(T\)

fully characterized by impulse response \(h\)

\[
y=T(x)=h * x
\]

also fully characterized by frequency response \(H=\mathcal{F}\{h\}\), if \(H\) is well-defined
BIBO stable system, \(h \in \ell_{1}\)
other systems: accumulator \(h=u\), …

Typically, convolution property implies
\[
Y=\mathcal{F}\{y\}=H X=\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\}
\]
Instead of computing \(x * h\), can do
\[
y=\mathcal{F}^{-1}(\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\})
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=b^{n} u[n]\), where \(|a|<1,|b|<1\) 方法 1. Direct convolution \(y=x * h\) 方法 2. Solve difference equation with initial rest condition
\[
y[n]-a y[n-1]=b^{n} u[n]
\]
方法 3. Fourier transform.
\[
H=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, X=\frac{1}{1-b e^{-j \omega}} \Longrightarrow Y=\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-b e^{-j \omega}\right)}
\]
If \(a \neq b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{a /(a-b)}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{b /(a-b)}{1-b e^{-j \omega}}, \quad y[n]=\frac{1}{a-b}\left(a^{n+1}-b^{n+1}\right) u[n]\) If \(a=b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{d}{d a}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right), y[n]=\frac{d}{d a} a^{n+1} u[n]=(n+1) a^{n} u[n]\) Or use \(Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{j}{a} e^{j \omega} \frac{d}{d \omega}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right)\) and differentiation property

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=\cos \left(\omega_{0} n\right),|a|<1\). Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
\begin{gathered}
x[n]=\frac{1}{2} e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega_{0} n} \\
y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}=\operatorname{Re} \frac{e^{j \omega_{0} n}}{1-a e^{-j \omega_{0}}} \\
=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-2 a \cos \omega_{0}+a^{2}}} \cos \left(\omega_{0} n-\arctan \frac{a \sin \omega_{0}}{1-a \cos \omega_{0}}\right)
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
方法 2. Use Fourier transform of \(X\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)+\pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)\right] \\
& Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{j\left(\omega_{0}-2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{-j\left(\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& =H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的乘积性质
\[
x[n] y[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast Y=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\]
NB. Dual of periodic convolution property of CTFS
\[
x \circledast y \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow} T \hat{x} \hat{y}
\]
Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x y\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n] y[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}\left(\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) e^{j \theta n} d \theta\right) y[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right)\left(\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} y[n] e^{-j(\omega-\theta) n}\right) d \theta \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
Frequency response of LTI system described by
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
x[n]=e^{j \omega n} \Longrightarrow y[n]=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega n}
\]
Substitution into difference equation yields
\[
\begin{gathered}
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega(n-k)}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{j \omega(n-k)} \\
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
方法 2. Take Fourier transform of both sides
\[
\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]\right\}=\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]\right\}
\]
By linearity and time-shifting property
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k} Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
By convolution property
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}{X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\]
Frequency response is rational function of \(e^{-j \omega}\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Consider LTI system described by
\[
y[n]-\frac{3}{4} y[n-1]+\frac{1}{8} y[n-2]=2 x[n]
\]
Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)}=\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Take inverse Fourier transform to obtain impulse response
\[
h[n]=4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n} u[n]-2\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Find response to \(x[n]=\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]\). Fourier transform of response
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=-\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)^{2}}+\frac{8}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Take inverse Fourier transform to obtain response
\[
y[n]=\left\{-4\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}-2(n+1)\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}+8\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}\right\} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
Replace \(e^{-j \omega}\) by \(z\),
\[
\begin{gathered}
H\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} z+\frac{1}{8} z^{2}}=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)}=\frac{A}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{B}{1-\frac{1}{4} z} \\
A=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}\right|_{z=2}=4 \\
B=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\end{gathered}
\]
NB. Terms take form \(\frac{A}{(s-r)^{m}}\) for CT, but \(\frac{A}{(1-r z)^{m}}\) for DT

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Replace \(e^{-j \omega}\) by \(z\),
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{1,1}\)

Multiply both side by \(1-\frac{1}{2} z\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=A_{1,1}+\frac{A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=2\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{2} z=0\)

\[
A_{1,1}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=2}=8
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{2,2}\)

Multiply both side by \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=4\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{4} z=0\)

\[
A_{2,2}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{2,1}\)

Multiply both side by \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} v}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

Differentiate both sides

\[
\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{1}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{d}{d z} \frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\left(-\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{4}}\right) A_{2,1}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=4\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{4} z=0\)

\[
A_{2,1}=\left.(-4)\left[\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{-4}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=4}=-4
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
section: 逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
text:
逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
Recall
\[
a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, \quad|a|<1
\]
i.e.
\[
\frac{1}{1-a z}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n} z^{n}, \quad z=e^{-j \omega}
\]
Differentiate \(m-1\) times w.r.t. \(z\)
\[
\frac{(m-1)!a^{m-1}}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n} \frac{n!}{(n-m+1)!} z^{n-(m-1)}
\]
\[
\frac{1}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n-m+1}\binom{n}{m-1} z^{n-m+1}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n}\binom{n+m-1}{m-1} z^{n}
\]
Thus
\[
\binom{n+m-1}{n} a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{m}}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
Spectrum of impulse train
\[
P\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right), \quad \omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{N}
\]
Spectrum of sampled signal
\[
X_{p}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \tilde{X} * P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X * \tilde{P}
\]
where \(\tilde{X}, \tilde{P}\) are respective parts of \(X, P\) within one period of \(2 \pi\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
First view: Replicating \(\tilde{X}\) at \(k \omega_{s}\) for \(k \in \mathbb{Z}\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
Second view: Replicating \(X\) at \(k \omega_{s}\) for \(k=0,1, \ldots, N-1\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text: 冲激列采样

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
离散时间采样定理
Band-limited DT signal \(x[n]\) whose spectrum \(X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=0\) for \(\omega_{M}<|\omega| \leq \pi\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x[k N], k \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{N}>2 \omega_{M}
\]
Given \(\{x[k N]: k \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x[n]\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(N\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=N\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

output \(x_{r}[n]\) with \(X_{r}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)\) is same as \(x[n]\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域重建

Impulse response of lowpass filter
\[
h[n]=\frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c} n\right)}{\pi n}
\]
\(x\) recovered by band-limited interpolation using sinc function
\[
x[n]=x_{r}[n]=\left(x_{p} * h\right)[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c}(n-k N)\right)}{\pi(n-k N)}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
DT signal \(x[n]\) 
Sampled signal
\[
x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]
\]

Decimated signal
\[
x_{b}[n]=x[n N]
\]
Reduces samples

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
\[
\begin{aligned}
X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{b}[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n N] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{k \in N \mathbb{Z}} x[k] e^{-j \omega k / N} \quad(k=n N) \\
& =\sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{p}[k] e^{-j \frac{\omega}{N} k} \quad\left(x_{p}[n]=0 \text { for } n \in \mathbb{Z} \backslash N \mathbb{Z}\right) \\
& =X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]
Recall \(X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)\) has period \(2 \pi / N\), so \(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega)}\right.\) has period \(2 \pi\). If no aliasing in sampling

\(X_{b}\) is stretched version of \(X\) in each period
\(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)\), but \(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \neq X\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
连续时间信号的采样
采样将连续时间 (CT) 信号转换为离散时间 (DT) 信号
连续时间信号 
离散时间信号 
\(T=\) 采样周期，均匀采样是最常用的方式。 采样技术使得我们可以利用数字电子设备来处理、记录、传输、存储和检索连续时间信号。

应用实例：MP3、数字相机、打印机

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
连续时间信号的采样
采样过程会损失信息，不同的信号可能会产生相同的样本序列：

\(x_{1}(t)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{3} t\right)\) 与 \(x_{2}(t)=\cos \left(\frac{7 \pi}{3} t\right)\) 是不同的信号。
但它们的采样序列 \(x_{1}[n]=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{3} n\right)\) 与 \(x_{2}[n]=\cos \left(\frac{7 \pi}{3} n\right)\) 是完全相同的。


关键问题： 在什么条件下，我们才能从样本中完全恢复原信号？

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
时域分析
连续时间信号 \(x(t)\) 
单位冲激串： \[
\begin{aligned}
& p(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T) \\
& x_{p}(t)=x(t) p(t) \\
& =\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
频域分析
连续时间信号频谱 \(X(j \omega)\) 
冲激串频谱： \[
\begin{aligned}
& P(j \omega)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right) \\
& X_{p}(j \omega)=\frac{1}{2 \pi}(X * P)(\omega) \\
& =\frac{1}{T} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} X\left(j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
频域限制与带宽
带限连续信号：当 \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) 时，\(X(j \omega)=0\)。
采样频率 \(\omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{T}\)
情况 1： \(\omega_{s}>2 \omega_{M}\) 频谱副本之间没有重叠，可以通过低通滤波器恢复 \(X\)。
情况 2： \(\omega_{s}<2 \omega_{M}\) 频谱副本发生重叠（混叠），无法恢复 \(X\)。

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
采样定理
对于频谱满足 \(X(j \omega)=0\)（当 \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) 时）的带限信号 \(x(t)\)，若满足以下条件，则该信号可由其样本 \(x(n T), n \in \mathbb{Z}\) 唯一确定：
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text{ 称为 奈奎斯特率 (Nyquist rate)}
\]
给定样本序列 \(\{x(n T)\}, x(t)\) 的重构步骤如下：

构造冲激串信号 \(x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)\)
将 \(x_{p}\) 通过增益为 \(T\)、截止频率为 \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\) 的低通滤波器： \[H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]\]
滤波器输出 \(x_{r}(t)\) 即为原信号 \(x(t)\)。

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
频域中的重建

奈奎斯特频率：\(\omega_{M}\)
奈奎斯特率：\(2 \omega_{M}\)

理想低通滤波器要求： - 增益：\(T\) - 截止频率范围：\(\omega_{M}<\omega_{c}<\omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域中的重建
低通滤波器的冲激响应： \[h(t)=\frac{T \sin \left(\omega_{c} t\right)}{\pi t}\]
通过使用 sinc 函数的带限插值来恢复 \(x\)： \[x(t)=x_{r}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \frac{T \sin \left(\omega_{c}(t-n T)\right)}{\pi(t-n T)}\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域中的重建（Whittaker-Shannon）
当设置截止频率 \(\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}=\frac{\pi}{T}\) 时，得到 Whittaker-Shannon 插值公式： \[x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text{其中 } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}\]
该公式实际上是一个正交展开。

text:
其他插值方法
除了理想的带限插值，实际工程中常用的方法还包括：

零阶保持 (Zero-order hold)
线性插值 (一阶保持)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
零阶保持 (ZOH)
重构信号： \[x_{0}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h_{0}\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) h_{0}(t-n T)\]
零阶保持滤波器响应： \[H_{0}(j \omega)=e^{-j \omega T / 2} \frac{2 \sin (\omega T / 2)}{\omega}\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
section: 线性插值 (一阶保持 FOH)
text:
线性插值 (一阶保持 FOH)
重构信号： \[x_{1}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h_{1}\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) h_{1}(t-n T)\]
一阶保持滤波器响应： \[H_{1}(j \omega)=\frac{1}{T}\left[\frac{\sin (\omega T / 2)}{\omega / 2}\right]^{2}\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
混叠 (Aliasing)
混叠会导致频率“折叠”：

当输入频率 \(\omega_{0} < \frac{1}{2} \omega_{s}\) 时：可以正确重构。
当输入频率 \(\omega_{0} > \frac{1}{2} \omega_{s}\) 时：重构信号会出现错误的频率 \(x_{r}(t)=\cos \left(\left(\omega_{s}-\omega_{0}\right) t-\phi\right)\)。

实例： 在电影中，快速转动的车轮看起来可能转得很慢，甚至反向旋转。

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抗混叠滤波器 (Anti-aliasing Filter)
在采样之前，先通过滤波器滤除高于 \(\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}\) 的频率分量，以防止混叠发生。

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的卷积性质
\[
(x * h)[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
注意： 这是连续时间傅里叶级数 (CTFS) 乘积性质的对偶。

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
LTI 系统的频率响应
LTI 系统 \(T\) 可以由以下方式完全表征： - 冲激响应 \(h\) - 频率响应 \(H=\mathcal{F}\{h\}\)（如果 \(H\) 存在）
通常，卷积性质意味着： \[Y = H X\] 与其计算繁琐的时域卷积 \(x * h\)，我们可以通过以下步骤获得输出： \[y=\mathcal{F}^{-1}(H \cdot X)\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的乘积性质
\[
x[n] y[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast Y = \frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\]
注意： 这是 CTFS 周期卷积性质的对偶。

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
section: 线性常系数差分方程描述的系统
text:
线性常系数差分方程描述的系统
对于由下式描述的 LTI 系统： \[\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]\]
其频率响应 \(H(e^{j\omega})\) 是 \(e^{-j\omega}\) 的有理函数： \[H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取 (Decimation)
抽取通过减少样本点来降低采样率： 1. 先进行采样：\(x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]\) 2. 得到抽取信号：\(x_{b}[n]=x[n N]\)
频谱关系： \[X_{b}(e^{j \omega}) = X_{p}(e^{j \omega / N})\] 如果不发生混叠，\(X_{b}\) 是 \(X\) 在每个周期内的展宽版本。

section: 连续时间信号的离散时间处理
text:
连续时间信号的离散时间处理
离散时间处理的优点： - 数字电子设备的通用性 - 较强的抗噪声能力
实际结构： - C/D 转换： 由模数转换器 (ADC) 实现。 - 离散处理： 使用 DSP 或计算机。 - D/C 转换： 由数模转换器 (DAC) 实现。
理想化假设： - 无量化误差 - C/D 建模为冲激串采样 - D/C 建模为理想低通重构

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
频率响应映射
整体连续时间系统的等效频率响应 \(H_{c}(j \omega)\) 与离散时间频率响应 \(H_{d}(e^{j \Omega})\) 的关系： \[H_{c}(j \omega)= \begin{cases}H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) & |\omega|<\frac{\omega_{s}}{2} \\ 0, & \text{其他}\end{cases}\]
即离散时间系统的频率响应是连续时间响应在频率上的归一化映射： \[H_{d}\left(e^{j \Omega}\right)=H_{c}\left(j \frac{\Omega}{T}\right),|\Omega|<\pi\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
采样定理
Band-limited CT signal \(x(t)\) whose spectrum \(X(j \omega)=0\) for \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x(n T), n \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text { called Nyquist rate }
\]
Given \(\{x(n T): n \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x(t)\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(T\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

filter output \(x_{r}(t)\) with \(X_{r}(j \omega)=X_{p}(j \omega) H(j \omega)\) is same as \(x(t)\)

Setting \(\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}\) yields Whittaker-Shannon interpolation formula
\[
x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text { where } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}
\]
Since
\[
\operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} T e^{-j n T \omega}\left[u\left(\omega+\frac{\pi}{T}\right)-u\left(\omega-\frac{\pi}{T}\right)\right]
\]
Parseval’s identity (or multiplication property) implies
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-m T}{T}\right) d t=\frac{T^{2}}{2 \pi} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{T}}^{\frac{\pi}{T}} e^{j(m-n) T \omega} d \omega=T \delta[n-m]
\]
Whittaker-Shannon formula is orthogonal expansion

text:
DTFT 的卷积性质
\[
(x * h)[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
NB. Dual of multiplication property of CTFS
\[
x(t) y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow}(\hat{x} * \hat{y})[k]
\]
NB. Similar to CTFT, applicable when formula is well-defined Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x * h\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}(x * h)[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} \sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] e^{-j \omega m} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \\
& =X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
LTI 系统的频率响应
LTI system \(T\)

fully characterized by impulse response \(h\)

\[
y=T(x)=h * x
\]

also fully characterized by frequency response \(H=\mathcal{F}\{h\}\), if \(H\) is well-defined
BIBO stable system, \(h \in \ell_{1}\)
other systems: accumulator \(h=u\), …

Typically, convolution property implies
\[
Y=\mathcal{F}\{y\}=H X=\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\}
\]
Instead of computing \(x * h\), can do
\[
y=\mathcal{F}^{-1}(\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\})
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=b^{n} u[n]\), where \(|a|<1,|b|<1\) 方法 1. Direct convolution \(y=x * h\) 方法 2. Solve difference equation with initial rest condition
\[
y[n]-a y[n-1]=b^{n} u[n]
\]
方法 3. Fourier transform.
\[
H=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, X=\frac{1}{1-b e^{-j \omega}} \Longrightarrow Y=\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-b e^{-j \omega}\right)}
\]
If \(a \neq b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{a /(a-b)}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{b /(a-b)}{1-b e^{-j \omega}}, \quad y[n]=\frac{1}{a-b}\left(a^{n+1}-b^{n+1}\right) u[n]\) If \(a=b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{d}{d a}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right), y[n]=\frac{d}{d a} a^{n+1} u[n]=(n+1) a^{n} u[n]\) Or use \(Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{j}{a} e^{j \omega} \frac{d}{d \omega}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right)\) and differentiation property

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=\cos \left(\omega_{0} n\right),|a|<1\). Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
\begin{gathered}
x[n]=\frac{1}{2} e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega_{0} n} \\
y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}=\operatorname{Re} \frac{e^{j \omega_{0} n}}{1-a e^{-j \omega_{0}}} \\
=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-2 a \cos \omega_{0}+a^{2}}} \cos \left(\omega_{0} n-\arctan \frac{a \sin \omega_{0}}{1-a \cos \omega_{0}}\right)
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
方法 2. Use Fourier transform of \(X\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)+\pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)\right] \\
& Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{j\left(\omega_{0}-2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{-j\left(\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& =H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}
\end{aligned}
\]

text:
DTFT 的乘积性质
\[
x[n] y[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast Y=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\]
NB. Dual of periodic convolution property of CTFS
\[
x \circledast y \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow} T \hat{x} \hat{y}
\]
Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x y\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n] y[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}\left(\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) e^{j \theta n} d \theta\right) y[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right)\left(\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} y[n] e^{-j(\omega-\theta) n}\right) d \theta \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
Frequency response of LTI system described by
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
x[n]=e^{j \omega n} \Longrightarrow y[n]=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega n}
\]
Substitution into difference equation yields
\[
\begin{gathered}
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega(n-k)}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{j \omega(n-k)} \\
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
方法 2. Take Fourier transform of both sides
\[
\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]\right\}=\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]\right\}
\]
By linearity and time-shifting property
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k} Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
By convolution property
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}{X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\]
Frequency response is rational function of \(e^{-j \omega}\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Consider LTI system described by
\[
y[n]-\frac{3}{4} y[n-1]+\frac{1}{8} y[n-2]=2 x[n]
\]
Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)}=\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Take inverse Fourier transform to obtain impulse response
\[
h[n]=4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n} u[n]-2\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Find response to \(x[n]=\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]\). Fourier transform of response
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=-\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)^{2}}+\frac{8}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Take inverse Fourier transform to obtain response
\[
y[n]=\left\{-4\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}-2(n+1)\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}+8\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}\right\} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
Replace \(e^{-j \omega}\) by \(z\),
\[
\begin{gathered}
H\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} z+\frac{1}{8} z^{2}}=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)}=\frac{A}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{B}{1-\frac{1}{4} z} \\
A=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}\right|_{z=2}=4 \\
B=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\end{gathered}
\]
NB. Terms take form \(\frac{A}{(s-r)^{m}}\) for CT, but \(\frac{A}{(1-r z)^{m}}\) for DT

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Replace \(e^{-j \omega}\) by \(z\),
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{1,1}\)

Multiply both side by \(1-\frac{1}{2} z\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=A_{1,1}+\frac{A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=2\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{2} z=0\)

\[
A_{1,1}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=2}=8
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{2,2}\)

Multiply both side by \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=4\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{4} z=0\)

\[
A_{2,2}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{2,1}\)

Multiply both side by \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} v}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

Differentiate both sides

\[
\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{1}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{d}{d z} \frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\left(-\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{4}}\right) A_{2,1}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=4\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{4} z=0\)

\[
A_{2,1}=\left.(-4)\left[\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{-4}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=4}=-4
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
section: 逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
text:
逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
Recall
\[
a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, \quad|a|<1
\]
i.e.
\[
\frac{1}{1-a z}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n} z^{n}, \quad z=e^{-j \omega}
\]
Differentiate \(m-1\) times w.r.t. \(z\)
\[
\frac{(m-1)!a^{m-1}}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n} \frac{n!}{(n-m+1)!} z^{n-(m-1)}
\]
\[
\frac{1}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n-m+1}\binom{n}{m-1} z^{n-m+1}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n}\binom{n+m-1}{m-1} z^{n}
\]
Thus
\[
\binom{n+m-1}{n} a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{m}}
\]

冲激列采样
DT signal \(x[n]\)
DT impulse train 
\[
p[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta[n-k N]
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \text { Sampled signal } \\
& \begin{aligned}
x_{p}[n] & =x[n] p[n] \\
& =\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
Spectrum of impulse train
\[
P\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right), \quad \omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{N}
\]
Spectrum of sampled signal
\[
X_{p}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \tilde{X} * P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X * \tilde{P}
\]
where \(\tilde{X}, \tilde{P}\) are respective parts of \(X, P\) within one period of \(2 \pi\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
First view: Replicating \(\tilde{X}\) at \(k \omega_{s}\) for \(k \in \mathbb{Z}\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
Second view: Replicating \(X\) at \(k \omega_{s}\) for \(k=0,1, \ldots, N-1\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
离散时间采样定理
Band-limited DT signal \(x[n]\) whose spectrum \(X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=0\) for \(\omega_{M}<|\omega| \leq \pi\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x[k N], k \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{N}>2 \omega_{M}
\]
Given \(\{x[k N]: k \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x[n]\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(N\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=N\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

output \(x_{r}[n]\) with \(X_{r}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)\) is same as \(x[n]\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域重建

Impulse response of lowpass filter
\[
h[n]=\frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c} n\right)}{\pi n}
\]
\(x\) recovered by band-limited interpolation using sinc function
\[
x[n]=x_{r}[n]=\left(x_{p} * h\right)[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c}(n-k N)\right)}{\pi(n-k N)}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
DT signal \(x[n]\) 
Sampled signal
\[
x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]
\]

Decimated signal
\[
x_{b}[n]=x[n N]
\]
Reduces samples

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
\[
\begin{aligned}
X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{b}[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n N] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{k \in N \mathbb{Z}} x[k] e^{-j \omega k / N} \quad(k=n N) \\
& =\sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{p}[k] e^{-j \frac{\omega}{N} k} \quad\left(x_{p}[n]=0 \text { for } n \in \mathbb{Z} \backslash N \mathbb{Z}\right) \\
& =X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]
Recall \(X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)\) has period \(2 \pi / N\), so \(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega)}\right.\) has period \(2 \pi\). If no aliasing in sampling

\(X_{b}\) is stretched version of \(X\) in each period
\(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)\), but \(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \neq X\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)\)

section: 连续时间信号的离散时间处理
text:
连续时间信号的离散时间处理

离散时间处理的优点

versatility of digital electronic devices
resilience against noise

在实际中

C/D implemented by analog-to-digital converter
D/C implemented by digital-to-analog converter

理想化假设

no quantization
C/D by impulse-train sampling
D/C by ideal reconstruction

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
模数转换（C/D）

Assumption

\(x_{c}(t)\) bandlimited, e.g. lowpass filtered
sampling above Nyquist rate, no aliasing

Relation between CT and DT spectra
\[
\begin{aligned}
X_{p}(j \omega) & =\mathrm{CTFT}\left\{\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{c}(n T) \delta(t-n T)\right\} \\
& =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{c}(n T) e^{-j \omega T n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{d}[n] e^{-j \omega T n}=X_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换

频域 连续时间信号频谱 \(X(j \omega)\)  冲激列
\[
\begin{aligned}
& P(j \omega)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right) \\
& X_{p}(j \omega)=\frac{1}{2 \pi}(X * P)(\omega) \\
& =\frac{1}{T} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} X\left(j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
频域 带限连续时间信号 当 \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) 时，\(X(j \omega)=0\) 
采样角频率 \(\omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{T}\)
情形 1：\(\omega_{s}>2 \omega_{M}\)，谱的各个副本之间不重叠，因此可通过低通滤波恢复 \(X\) 
情形 2：\(\omega_{s}<2 \omega_{M}\)，谱副本发生重叠，因此无法恢复 \(X\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
采样定理
若带限连续时间信号 \(x(t)\) 的频谱满足当 \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) 时 \(X(j \omega)=0\)，则在下述条件下，它可由样本 \(x(nT),\ n\in\mathbb{Z}\) 唯一确定：
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text { 称为奈奎斯特速率 }
\]
已知样本集合 \(\{x(nT):n\in\mathbb{Z}\}\)，则 \(x(t)\) 可按如下步骤重建：

构造 \(x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)\)
令 \(x_p\) 通过一个增益为 \(T\)、截止频率为 \(\omega_c\in(\omega_M,\omega_s-\omega_M)\) 的低通滤波器，即

\[
H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

滤波器输出 \(x_r(t)\) 满足 \(X_r(j\omega)=X_p(j\omega)H(j\omega)\)，并且它与原信号 \(x(t)\) 相同

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域中的重建
令 \(\omega_c=\frac{\omega_s}{2}\)，可得到 Whittaker–Shannon 插值公式
\[
x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text { 其中 } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}
\]
由于
\[
\operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} T e^{-j n T \omega}\left[u\left(\omega+\frac{\pi}{T}\right)-u\left(\omega-\frac{\pi}{T}\right)\right]
\]
由 Parseval 恒等式（或乘积性质）可得
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-m T}{T}\right) d t=\frac{T^{2}}{2 \pi} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{T}}^{\frac{\pi}{T}} e^{j(m-n) T \omega} d \omega=T \delta[n-m]
\]
Whittaker–Shannon 公式本质上是一个正交展开

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的卷积性质
\[
(x * h)[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
注意：这与连续时间傅里叶级数（CTFS）的乘积性质互为对偶
\[
x(t) y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow}(\hat{x} * \hat{y})[k]
\]
注意：这与连续时间傅里叶变换（CTFT）的情形类似，只要公式有定义即可。证明如下。
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x * h\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}(x * h)[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} \sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] e^{-j \omega m} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \\
& =X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
LTI 系统的频率响应
LTI 系统 \(T\)

可由冲激响应 \(h\) 完全表征

\[
y=T(x)=h * x
\]

若 \(H=\mathcal{F}\{h\}\) 有定义，也可由频率响应 \(H\) 完全表征
对于 BIBO 稳定系统，有 \(h\in\ell_1\)
其他系统例如累加器，其 \(h=u\)，等等

通常由卷积性质可知
\[
Y=\mathcal{F}\{y\}=H X=\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\}
\]
因此，不必直接计算 \(x*h\)，也可以改为
\[
y=\mathcal{F}^{-1}(\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\})
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
求冲激响应为 \(h[n]=a^n u[n]\) 的 LTI 系统对输入 \(x[n]=b^n u[n]\) 的响应，其中 \(|a|<1, |b|<1\) 方法 1：直接卷积 \(y=x*h\) 方法 2：在初始静止条件下求解差分方程
\[
y[n]-a y[n-1]=b^{n} u[n]
\]
方法 3：傅里叶变换
\[
H=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, X=\frac{1}{1-b e^{-j \omega}} \Longrightarrow Y=\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-b e^{-j \omega}\right)}
\]
若 \(a\neq b\)， Y(e^{j })=-, y[n]=(a{n+1}-b{n+1}) u[n]$ 若 \(a=b\)， Y(e^{j })=(), y[n]= a^{n+1} u[n]=(n+1) a^{n} u[n]$ 或者也可利用 \(Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{j}{a} e^{j \omega} \frac{d}{d \omega}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right)\) and differentiation property

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
求冲激响应为 \(h[n]=a^n u[n]\) 的 LTI 系统对输入 \(x[n]=\cos\left(\omega_0 n\right)\) 的响应，其中 \(|a|<1\)。 频率响应
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}
\]
方法 1：利用特征函数性质
\[
\begin{gathered}
x[n]=\frac{1}{2} e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega_{0} n} \\
y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}=\operatorname{Re} \frac{e^{j \omega_{0} n}}{1-a e^{-j \omega_{0}}} \\
=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-2 a \cos \omega_{0}+a^{2}}} \cos \left(\omega_{0} n-\arctan \frac{a \sin \omega_{0}}{1-a \cos \omega_{0}}\right)
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
方法 2：利用 \(X\) 的傅里叶变换
\[
\begin{aligned}
& X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)+\pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)\right] \\
& Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{j\left(\omega_{0}-2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{-j\left(\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& =H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的乘积性质
\[
x[n] y[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast Y=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\]
注意：这与连续时间傅里叶级数的周期卷积性质互为对偶
\[
x \circledast y \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow} T \hat{x} \hat{y}
\]
证明：
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x y\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n] y[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}\left(\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) e^{j \theta n} d \theta\right) y[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right)\left(\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} y[n] e^{-j(\omega-\theta) n}\right) d \theta \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
由下式所描述的 LTI 系统的频率响应
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]
\]
方法 1：利用特征函数性质
\[
x[n]=e^{j \omega n} \Longrightarrow y[n]=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega n}
\]
代入差分方程可得
\[
\begin{gathered}
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega(n-k)}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{j \omega(n-k)} \\
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
方法 2：对方程两边取傅里叶变换
\[
\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]\right\}=\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]\right\}
\]
由线性性质与时移性质可得
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k} Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
由卷积性质可得
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}{X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\]
频率响应是关于 \(e^{-j\omega}\) 的有理函数

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
考虑如下 LTI 系统
\[
y[n]-\frac{3}{4} y[n-1]+\frac{1}{8} y[n-2]=2 x[n]
\]
频率响应
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
通过部分分式展开
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)}=\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
取逆傅里叶变换得到冲激响应
\[
h[n]=4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n} u[n]-2\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
求系统对输入 \(x[n]=\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^n u[n]\) 的响应。 响应的傅里叶变换
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
通过部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=-\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)^{2}}+\frac{8}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
取逆傅里叶变换得到响应
\[
y[n]=\left\{-4\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}-2(n+1)\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}+8\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}\right\} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
令 \(e^{-j\omega}\) 记作 \(z\)，
\[
\begin{gathered}
H\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} z+\frac{1}{8} z^{2}}=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)}=\frac{A}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{B}{1-\frac{1}{4} z} \\
A=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}\right|_{z=2}=4 \\
B=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\end{gathered}
\]
注意：连续时间（CT）中对应项通常写成 \(\frac{A}{(s-r)^m}\)，而离散时间（DT）中对应项写成 \(\frac{A}{(1-rz)^m}\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
令 \(e^{-j\omega}\) 记作 \(z\)，
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
为求 \(A_{1,1}\)

两边同乘 \(1-\frac{1}{2}z\)，

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=A_{1,1}+\frac{A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]

令 \(z=2\)，即取 \(1-\frac{1}{2}z=0\) 的根

\[
A_{1,1}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=2}=8
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
为求 \(A_{2,2}\)

两边同乘 \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4}z\right)^2\)，

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

令 \(z=4\)，即取 \(1-\frac{1}{4}z=0\) 的根

\[
A_{2,2}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
为求 \(A_{2,1}\)

两边同乘 \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4}z\right)^2\)，

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} v}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

对等式两边求导

\[
\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{1}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{d}{d z} \frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\left(-\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{4}}\right) A_{2,1}
\]

再令 \(z=4\)，即取 \(1-\frac{1}{4}z=0\) 的根

\[
A_{2,1}=\left.(-4)\left[\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{-4}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=4}=-4
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
section: 逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
text:
逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
回顾
\[
a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, \quad|a|<1
\]
即
\[
\frac{1}{1-a z}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n} z^{n}, \quad z=e^{-j \omega}
\]
关于 \(z\) 求 \(m-1\) 次导数
\[
\frac{(m-1)!a^{m-1}}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n} \frac{n!}{(n-m+1)!} z^{n-(m-1)}
\]
\[
\frac{1}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n-m+1}\binom{n}{m-1} z^{n-m+1}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n}\binom{n+m-1}{m-1} z^{n}
\]
因此
\[
\binom{n+m-1}{n} a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{m}}
\]

冲激列采样
离散时间信号 \(x[n]\)
离散时间冲激列 
\[
p[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta[n-k N]
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \text { 采样后的信号 } \\
& \begin{aligned}
x_{p}[n] & =x[n] p[n] \\
& =\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
冲激列的频谱
\[
P\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right), \quad \omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{N}
\]
采样信号的频谱
\[
X_{p}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \tilde{X} * P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X * \tilde{P}
\]
其中 \(\tilde X,\tilde P\) 分别表示 \(X,P\) 在一个 \(2\pi\) 周期内对应的部分
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
第一种看法：将 \(\tilde X\) 在 \(k\omega_s\) 处复制，其中 \(k\in\mathbb{Z}\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
冲激列采样
第二种看法：将 \(X\) 在 \(k\omega_s\) 处复制，其中 \(k=0,1,\ldots,N-1\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text: 冲激列采样

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
离散时间采样定理
若带限离散时间信号 \(x[n]\) 的频谱满足对 \(\omega_M<|\omega|\le \pi\) 有 \(X(e^{j\omega})=0\)，则在下述条件下，它可由样本 \(x[kN],\ k\in\mathbb{Z}\) 唯一确定：
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{N}>2 \omega_{M}
\]
已知样本集合 \(\{x[kN]:k\in\mathbb{Z}\}\)，则 \(x[n]\) 可以按如下方式重建：

construct \(x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]\)
令 \(x_p\) 通过一个增益为 \(N\)、截止频率为 \(\omega_c\in(\omega_M,\omega_s-\omega_M)\) 的低通滤波器，即

\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=N\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

输出 \(x_r[n]\) 满足 \(X_r(e^{j\omega})=X_p(e^{j\omega})H(e^{j\omega})\)，且与原信号 \(x[n]\) 相同

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域重建

低通滤波器的冲激响应
\[
h[n]=\frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c} n\right)}{\pi n}
\]
可利用 sinc 函数进行带限插值，从而恢复 \(x\)
\[
x[n]=x_{r}[n]=\left(x_{p} * h\right)[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c}(n-k N)\right)}{\pi(n-k N)}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
离散时间信号 \(x[n]\) 
采样后的信号
\[
x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]
\]

抽取后的信号
\[
x_{b}[n]=x[n N]
\]
样本数减少

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
\[
\begin{aligned}
X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{b}[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n N] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{k \in N \mathbb{Z}} x[k] e^{-j \omega k / N} \quad(k=n N) \\
& =\sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{p}[k] e^{-j \frac{\omega}{N} k} \quad\left(x_{p}[n]=0 \text { for } n \in \mathbb{Z} \backslash N \mathbb{Z}\right) \\
& =X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]
回顾：\(X_p(e^{j\omega})\) 的周期为 \(2\pi/N\)，因此 \(X_b(e^{j\omega})\) 的周期为 \(2\pi\)。 若采样中未发生混叠

在每个周期内，\(X_b\) 是 \(X\) 的拉伸版本
\(X_b(e^{j\omega})=X_p(e^{j\omega/N})\)，但 \(X_b(e^{j\omega})\neq X(e^{j\omega/N})\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
模数转换（C/D）

假设

\(x_c(t)\) 为带限信号，例如已经过低通滤波
采样频率高于奈奎斯特速率，因此无混叠

连续时间与离散时间频谱之间的关系
\[
\begin{aligned}
X_{p}(j \omega) & =\mathrm{CTFT}\left\{\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{c}(n T) \delta(t-n T)\right\} \\
& =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{c}(n T) e^{-j \omega T n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{d}[n] e^{-j \omega T n}=X_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
频率响应


\(Y_{d}\left(e^{j \Omega}\right)=H_{d}\left(e^{j \Omega}\right) X_{d}\left(e^{j \Omega}\right)\)
\(Y_{p}(j \omega)=Y_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right)=H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) X_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right)=H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) X_{p}(j \omega)\)
\(Y_{c}(j \omega)=Y_{p}(j \omega) H_{\mathrm{lp}}(j \omega)=H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) X_{p}(j \omega) H_{\mathrm{lp}}(j \omega)=H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) X_{c}(j \omega)\)
\(H_{c}(j \omega)= \begin{cases}H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) & |\omega|<\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}=\frac{\omega}{T} \\ 0, & \text { otherwise }\end{cases}\)

频率响应
\[
\begin{gathered}
H_{c}(j \omega)= \begin{cases}H_{d}\left(e^{j \omega T}\right) & |\omega|<\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}=\frac{\omega}{T} \\
0, & \text { otherwise }\end{cases} \\
\Longrightarrow H_{d}\left(e^{j \Omega}\right)=H_{c}\left(j \frac{\Omega}{T}\right),|\Omega|<\pi
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
采样定理
Band-limited CT signal \(x(t)\) whose spectrum \(X(j \omega)=0\) for \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x(n T), n \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text { called Nyquist rate }
\]
Given \(\{x(n T): n \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x(t)\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(T\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

filter output \(x_{r}(t)\) with \(X_{r}(j \omega)=X_{p}(j \omega) H(j \omega)\) is same as \(x(t)\)

text:
时域中的重建
Setting \(\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}\) yields Whittaker-Shannon interpolation formula
\[
x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text { where } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}
\]
Since
\[
\operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} T e^{-j n T \omega}\left[u\left(\omega+\frac{\pi}{T}\right)-u\left(\omega-\frac{\pi}{T}\right)\right]
\]
Parseval’s identity (or multiplication property) implies
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-m T}{T}\right) d t=\frac{T^{2}}{2 \pi} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{T}}^{\frac{\pi}{T}} e^{j(m-n) T \omega} d \omega=T \delta[n-m]
\]
Whittaker-Shannon formula is orthogonal expansion

text:
DTFT 的卷积性质
\[
(x * h)[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
NB. Dual of multiplication property of CTFS
\[
x(t) y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow}(\hat{x} * \hat{y})[k]
\]
NB. Similar to CTFT, applicable when formula is well-defined Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x * h\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}(x * h)[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} \sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] e^{-j \omega m} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \\
& =X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
LTI 系统的频率响应
LTI system \(T\)

fully characterized by impulse response \(h\)

\[
y=T(x)=h * x
\]

also fully characterized by frequency response \(H=\mathcal{F}\{h\}\), if \(H\) is well-defined
BIBO stable system, \(h \in \ell_{1}\)
other systems: accumulator \(h=u\), …

Typically, convolution property implies
\[
Y=\mathcal{F}\{y\}=H X=\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\}
\]
Instead of computing \(x * h\), can do
\[
y=\mathcal{F}^{-1}(\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\})
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=b^{n} u[n]\), where \(|a|<1,|b|<1\) 方法 1. Direct convolution \(y=x * h\) 方法 2. Solve difference equation with initial rest condition
\[
y[n]-a y[n-1]=b^{n} u[n]
\]
方法 3. Fourier transform.
\[
H=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, X=\frac{1}{1-b e^{-j \omega}} \Longrightarrow Y=\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-b e^{-j \omega}\right)}
\]
If \(a \neq b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{a /(a-b)}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{b /(a-b)}{1-b e^{-j \omega}}, \quad y[n]=\frac{1}{a-b}\left(a^{n+1}-b^{n+1}\right) u[n]\) If \(a=b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{d}{d a}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right), y[n]=\frac{d}{d a} a^{n+1} u[n]=(n+1) a^{n} u[n]\) Or use \(Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{j}{a} e^{j \omega} \frac{d}{d \omega}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right)\) and differentiation property

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=\cos \left(\omega_{0} n\right),|a|<1\). Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
\begin{gathered}
x[n]=\frac{1}{2} e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega_{0} n} \\
y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}=\operatorname{Re} \frac{e^{j \omega_{0} n}}{1-a e^{-j \omega_{0}}} \\
=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-2 a \cos \omega_{0}+a^{2}}} \cos \left(\omega_{0} n-\arctan \frac{a \sin \omega_{0}}{1-a \cos \omega_{0}}\right)
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
方法 2. Use Fourier transform of \(X\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)+\pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)\right] \\
& Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{j\left(\omega_{0}-2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{-j\left(\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& =H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}
\end{aligned}
\]

text:
DTFT 的乘积性质
\[
x[n] y[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast Y=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\]
NB. Dual of periodic convolution property of CTFS
\[
x \circledast y \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow} T \hat{x} \hat{y}
\]
Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x y\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n] y[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}\left(\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) e^{j \theta n} d \theta\right) y[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right)\left(\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} y[n] e^{-j(\omega-\theta) n}\right) d \theta \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
Frequency response of LTI system described by
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
x[n]=e^{j \omega n} \Longrightarrow y[n]=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega n}
\]
Substitution into difference equation yields
\[
\begin{gathered}
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) e^{j \omega(n-k)}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{j \omega(n-k)} \\
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
Linear Constant-coefficient Difference Equations
方法 2. Take Fourier transform of both sides
\[
\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} y[n-k]\right\}=\mathcal{F}\left\{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} x[n-k]\right\}
\]
By linearity and time-shifting property
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k} Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
By convolution property
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}{X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)}=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} e^{-j \omega k}}
\]
Frequency response is rational function of \(e^{-j \omega}\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Consider LTI system described by
\[
y[n]-\frac{3}{4} y[n-1]+\frac{1}{8} y[n-2]=2 x[n]
\]
Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)}=\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Take inverse Fourier transform to obtain impulse response
\[
h[n]=4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n} u[n]-2\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Find response to \(x[n]=\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n} u[n]\). Fourier transform of response
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=-\frac{4}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)^{2}}+\frac{8}{1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Take inverse Fourier transform to obtain response
\[
y[n]=\left\{-4\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}-2(n+1)\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{n}+8\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}\right\} u[n]
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} e^{-j \omega}+\frac{1}{8} e^{-j 2 \omega}}
\]
Replace \(e^{-j \omega}\) by \(z\),
\[
\begin{gathered}
H\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{3}{4} z+\frac{1}{8} z^{2}}=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)}=\frac{A}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{B}{1-\frac{1}{4} z} \\
A=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}\right|_{z=2}=4 \\
B=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right) H\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\end{gathered}
\]
NB. Terms take form \(\frac{A}{(s-r)^{m}}\) for CT, but \(\frac{A}{(1-r z)^{m}}\) for DT

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{4} e^{-j \omega}}
\]
Replace \(e^{-j \omega}\) by \(z\),
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{1,1}\)

Multiply both side by \(1-\frac{1}{2} z\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=A_{1,1}+\frac{A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=2\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{2} z=0\)

\[
A_{1,1}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right) Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=2}=\left.\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=2}=8
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{2,2}\)

Multiply both side by \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=4\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{4} z=0\)

\[
A_{2,2}=\left.\left[\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}\right|_{z=4}=-2
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
部分分式展开
\[
Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{A_{1,1}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\frac{A_{2,1}}{1-\frac{1}{4} z}+\frac{A_{2,2}}{\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}
\]
To find \(A_{2,1}\)

Multiply both side by \(\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}\),

\[
\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{2}{1-\frac{1}{2} v}=\frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+A_{2,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)+A_{2,2}
\]

Differentiate both sides

\[
\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)=\frac{1}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}=\frac{d}{d z} \frac{A_{1,1}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2} z}+\left(-\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{4}}\right) A_{2,1}
\]

Evaluate at \(z=4\), i.e. root of \(1-\frac{1}{4} z=0\)

\[
A_{2,1}=\left.(-4)\left[\frac{d}{d z}\left(1-\frac{1}{4} z\right)^{2} Y\left(z^{-1}\right)\right]\right|_{z=4}=\left.\frac{-4}{\left(1-\frac{1}{2} z\right)^{2}}\right|_{z=4}=-4
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
section: 逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
text:
逆傅里叶变换 of \(\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{n}}\)
Recall
\[
a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, \quad|a|<1
\]
i.e.
\[
\frac{1}{1-a z}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n} z^{n}, \quad z=e^{-j \omega}
\]
Differentiate \(m-1\) times w.r.t. \(z\)
\[
\frac{(m-1)!a^{m-1}}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n} \frac{n!}{(n-m+1)!} z^{n-(m-1)}
\]
\[
\frac{1}{(1-a z)^{m}}=\sum_{n=m-1}^{\infty} a^{n-m+1}\binom{n}{m-1} z^{n-m+1}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a^{n}\binom{n+m-1}{m-1} z^{n}
\]
Thus
\[
\binom{n+m-1}{n} a^{n} u[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)^{m}}
\]

Spectrum of impulse train
\[
P\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\omega_{s} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right), \quad \omega_{s}=\frac{2 \pi}{N}
\]
Spectrum of sampled signal
\[
X_{p}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \tilde{X} * P=\frac{1}{2 \pi} X * \tilde{P}
\]
where \(\tilde{X}, \tilde{P}\) are respective parts of \(X, P\) within one period of \(2 \pi\)
\[
X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \tilde{X}\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)=\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} X\left(e^{j\left(\omega-k \omega_{s}\right)}\right)
\]

\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
离散时间采样定理
Band-limited DT signal \(x[n]\) whose spectrum \(X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=0\) for \(\omega_{M}<|\omega| \leq \pi\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x[k N], k \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{N}>2 \omega_{M}
\]
Given \(\{x[k N]: k \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x[n]\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(N\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=N\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

output \(x_{r}[n]\) with \(X_{r}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)\) is same as \(x[n]\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域重建

Impulse response of lowpass filter
\[
h[n]=\frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c} n\right)}{\pi n}
\]
\(x\) recovered by band-limited interpolation using sinc function
\[
x[n]=x_{r}[n]=\left(x_{p} * h\right)[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \frac{N \sin \left(\omega_{c}(n-k N)\right)}{\pi(n-k N)}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
DT signal \(x[n]\) 
Sampled signal
\[
x_{p}[n]=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} x[k N] \delta[n-k N]
\]

Decimated signal
\[
x_{b}[n]=x[n N]
\]
Reduces samples

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
抽取
\[
\begin{aligned}
X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{b}[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n N] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{k \in N \mathbb{Z}} x[k] e^{-j \omega k / N} \quad(k=n N) \\
& =\sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} x_{p}[k] e^{-j \frac{\omega}{N} k} \quad\left(x_{p}[n]=0 \text { for } n \in \mathbb{Z} \backslash N \mathbb{Z}\right) \\
& =X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]
Recall \(X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)\) has period \(2 \pi / N\), so \(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega)}\right.\) has period \(2 \pi\). If no aliasing in sampling

\(X_{b}\) is stretched version of \(X\) in each period
\(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=X_{p}\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)\), but \(X_{b}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \neq X\left(e^{j \omega / N}\right)\)

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
采样定理
Band-limited CT signal \(x(t)\) whose spectrum \(X(j \omega)=0\) for \(|\omega|>\omega_{M}\) is uniquely determined by its samples \(x(n T), n \in \mathbb{Z}\) if
\[
\omega_{s} \triangleq \frac{2 \pi}{T}>2 \omega_{M}, \quad 2 \omega_{M} \text { called Nyquist rate }
\]
Given \(\{x(n T): n \in \mathbb{Z}\}, x(t)\) can be reconstructed as follows

construct \(x_{p}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \delta(t-n T)\)
send \(x_{p}\) through lowpass filter with gain \(T\) and cutoff frequency \(\omega_{c} \in\left(\omega_{M}, \omega_{s}-\omega_{M}\right)\), i.e.

\[
H(j \omega)=T\left[u\left(\omega+\omega_{c}\right)-u\left(\omega-\omega_{c}\right)\right]
\]

filter output \(x_{r}(t)\) with \(X_{r}(j \omega)=X_{p}(j \omega) H(j \omega)\) is same as \(x(t)\)

\]

\[

\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换

时域中的重建
\[
x(t) \xrightarrow{\phi} x_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} \delta(t-n T)

\[
h(t)=\frac{T \sin \left(\omega_{c} t\right)}{\pi t}
\]
\(x\) recovered by band-limited interpolation using sinc function
\[
x(t)=x_{r}(t)=\left(x_{p} * h\right)(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \frac{T \sin \left(\omega_{c}(t-n T)\right)}{\pi(t-n T)}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
时域中的重建
Setting \(\omega_{c}=\frac{\omega_{s}}{2}\) yields Whittaker-Shannon interpolation formula
\[
x_{r}(t)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n T) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right), \quad \text { where } \operatorname{sinc}(t)=\frac{\sin (\pi t)}{\pi t}
\]
Since
\[
\operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} T e^{-j n T \omega}\left[u\left(\omega+\frac{\pi}{T}\right)-u\left(\omega-\frac{\pi}{T}\right)\right]
\]
Parseval’s identity (or multiplication property) implies
\[
\int_{\mathbb{R}} \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-n T}{T}\right) \operatorname{sinc}\left(\frac{t-m T}{T}\right) d t=\frac{T^{2}}{2 \pi} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{T}}^{\frac{\pi}{T}} e^{j(m-n) T \omega} d \omega=T \delta[n-m]
\]
Whittaker-Shannon formula is orthogonal expansion

text:
DTFT 的卷积性质
\[
(x * h)[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\]
NB. Dual of multiplication property of CTFS
\[
x(t) y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow}(\hat{x} * \hat{y})[k]
\]
NB. Similar to CTFT, applicable when formula is well-defined Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x * h\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}(x * h)[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} \sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} h[n-m] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}} x[m] e^{-j \omega m} H\left(e^{j \omega}\right) \\
& =X\left(e^{j \omega}\right) H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
LTI 系统的频率响应
LTI system \(T\)

fully characterized by impulse response \(h\)

\[
y=T(x)=h * x
\]

also fully characterized by frequency response \(H=\mathcal{F}\{h\}\), if \(H\) is well-defined
BIBO stable system, \(h \in \ell_{1}\)
other systems: accumulator \(h=u\), …

Typically, convolution property implies
\[
Y=\mathcal{F}\{y\}=H X=\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\}
\]
Instead of computing \(x * h\), can do
\[
y=\mathcal{F}^{-1}(\mathcal{F}\{h\} \mathcal{F}\{x\})
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=b^{n} u[n]\), where \(|a|<1,|b|<1\) 方法 1. Direct convolution \(y=x * h\) 方法 2. Solve difference equation with initial rest condition
\[
y[n]-a y[n-1]=b^{n} u[n]
\]
方法 3. Fourier transform.
\[
H=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}, X=\frac{1}{1-b e^{-j \omega}} \Longrightarrow Y=\frac{1}{\left(1-a e^{-j \omega}\right)\left(1-b e^{-j \omega}\right)}
\]
If \(a \neq b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{a /(a-b)}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}-\frac{b /(a-b)}{1-b e^{-j \omega}}, \quad y[n]=\frac{1}{a-b}\left(a^{n+1}-b^{n+1}\right) u[n]\) If \(a=b, Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{d}{d a}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right), y[n]=\frac{d}{d a} a^{n+1} u[n]=(n+1) a^{n} u[n]\) Or use \(Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{j}{a} e^{j \omega} \frac{d}{d \omega}\left(\frac{a}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}\right)\) and differentiation property

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
Response of LTI system with impulse response \(h[n]=a^{n} u[n]\) to input \(x[n]=\cos \left(\omega_{0} n\right),|a|<1\). Frequency response
\[
H\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\frac{1}{1-a e^{-j \omega}}
\]
方法 1. Use eigenfunction property
\[
\begin{gathered}
x[n]=\frac{1}{2} e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} e^{-j \omega_{0} n} \\
y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}=\operatorname{Re} \frac{e^{j \omega_{0} n}}{1-a e^{-j \omega_{0}}} \\
=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-2 a \cos \omega_{0}+a^{2}}} \cos \left(\omega_{0} n-\arctan \frac{a \sin \omega_{0}}{1-a \cos \omega_{0}}\right)
\end{gathered}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
例
方法 2. Use Fourier transform of \(X\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& X\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)+\pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)\right] \\
& Y\left(e^{j \omega}\right)=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{j\left(\omega_{0}-2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi H\left(e^{-j\left(\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right)}\right) \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& =H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega-\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& \quad+H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) \sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty} \pi \delta\left(\omega+\omega_{0}+2 k \pi\right) \\
& y[n]=\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{j \omega_{0} n}+\frac{1}{2} H\left(e^{-j \omega_{0}}\right) e^{-j \omega_{0} n}
\end{aligned}
\]

title: 第五章 离散时间傅里叶变换
text:
DTFT 的乘积性质
\[
x[n] y[n] \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{2 \pi} X \circledast Y=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\]
NB. Dual of periodic convolution property of CTFS
\[
x \circledast y \stackrel{\mathcal{F S}}{\longleftrightarrow} T \hat{x} \hat{y}
\]
Proof.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{F}\{x y\}\left(e^{j \omega}\right) & =\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} x[n] y[n] e^{-j \omega n}=\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}\left(\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) e^{j \theta n} d \theta\right) y[n] e^{-j \omega n} \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right)\left(\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} y[n] e^{-j(\omega-\theta) n}\right) d \theta \\
& =\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{2 \pi} X\left(e^{j \theta}\right) Y\left(e^{j(\omega-\theta)}\right) d \theta
\end{aligned}
\]
